title: Controlled roll and recovery
goal: Tune the transition timing around Microduck's official shipped roulade policy so the robot completes an inversion, returns upright, and stops close to where it started.

training.algorithm: deterministic grid search over roll-policy handoff timing

disclosure: The joint-level roulade network is the official shipped Microduck policy and remains frozen. The learned component is the high-level handoff time from roulade to the standing policy. Training searches 26 candidate timings and evaluation perturbs the initial joint pose across three fixed seeds.
